newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at lows, March holds support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at lows, March holds support.

text.p: CSCE March world sugar prices fell to support at 10.30 as trade scale-down buying kept the contract from accumulating additional losses, floor sources said.
They said a move below support could trigger aggressive speculative selling and pressure the March contract to major support at 10.23, the recent low made December 3.
Several market sources expect lower prices Tuesday based on today's weak close, and cited stops in the 10.20 cent a lb range.
Trade scale-down buying at every tick could support the market, dealers said.
March ended 0.10 cent a lb lower to 10.30 cents, traded 10.43 to 10.30. May eased 0.07 on the day to 10.45, while the back months finished unchanged to up 0.01.
